title: mogorium triflorum
intro: Mogorium triflorum, commonly known as 'Three-Flowered Wintergreen', is a type of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mogorium triflorum include acting as an expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include methyl salicylate, salicylic acid, and essential oils like limonene and borneol.
